pt.title: Painel de vagas e funil de candidaturas
pt.impact: Visão clara de cada etapa e follow-ups.
pt.body: Atualiza a etapa de cada candidatura por voz (entrevista, oferta, recusa), mantém um painel com funil e cartões e cobra follow-ups vencidos, ignorando quem já respondeu.

en.title: Job board and application funnel
en.impact: A clear view of every stage and follow-up.
en.body: Updates each application's stage by voice (interview, offer, rejection), keeps a funnel dashboard with cards and flags overdue follow-ups, skipping those who already replied.
